29600.meaning1: disappeared right there; vanished on the spot

examples.text: idam'avoca, bhikkhave, tāyano devaputto, idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth'ev'antaradhāyi.
idaṃ vatvā tatth'ev'antaradhāyi.

29601.meaning1: disappeared right there; vanished on the spot

examples.text: idam'avoca kassapo devaputto, samanuñño satthā ahosi. atha kho kassapo devaputto samanuñño me satthā'ti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.
atha kho māro pāpimā, jānāti maṃ uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī'ti dukkhī dummano tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhoganagare viharati ānandacetiye. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti. bhadante'ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatra-abhinandinī, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā
yo me ayaṃ attā vado vedeyyo tatra tatra kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti so kho pana me ayaṃ attā nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassatī'ti.

29604.meaning1: this or that; any; each and every; here and there

examples.text: yassa kassaci ca abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti. bhadante'ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca

29606.meaning1: in that case; in that regard; in this matter; in this connection

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū sampayojesuṃ, tatra-eko bhikkhu accasarā, atha kho so bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno santike accayaṃ accayato deseti, so bhikkhu nappaṭiggaṇhāti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggam'akkhāyati.

29607.meaning1: there a certain one; in this case one (of)

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ pūraṇo kassapo anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ deseti. tatr'aññataro pūraṇassa kassapassa sāvako saddam'akāsi, mā bhonto pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ etam'atthaṃ pucchittha, n'eso etaṃ jānāti, mayam'etaṃ jānāma, amhe etam'atthaṃ pucchatha, mayam'etaṃ bhavantānaṃ byākarissāmā'ti.

29608.meaning2: being there; belonging to that place

29610.meaning1: cover which remains in place (on the bed)

29612.meaning1: here and there; everywhere; all over

examples.text: kathaṃ pan'āvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hotī'ti? avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ kho, āvuso, sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ tatratatr'ābhinandanā, evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hotī'ti.
y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā

29613.meaning1: thoroughly enjoying this and that; taking delight here and there; relishing this and that
29613.commentary: (MNa) tatrātatr'ābhinandanā'ti rūp'ābhinandanā sadd'ābhinandanā'ti evaṃ tahiṃ tahiṃ abhinandanā, karaṇavacane c'etaṃ paccattaṃ. tatratatr'ābhinandanāya punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: kathaṃ pan'āvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hotī'ti? avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ kho, āvuso, sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ tatratatr'ābhinandanā, evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hotī'ti.

29614.meaning1: who takes delight here and there; thoroughly enjoying this and that; very happy with this and that

examples.text: y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā
yam'pi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā denti, tatra'p'ime mukh'āvaraṇaṃ maññe karontī'ti.

29617.meaning1: there would be; there could be; there might be

examples.text: tatr'assa kāṇo kacchapo. so vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjeyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ, tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā

29618.meaning1: in that case it would be

examples.text: āhāretī'ti c'āhaṃ vadeyyaṃ, tatr'assa kallo pañho, ko nu kho, bhante, āhāretī'ti? evaṃ c'āhaṃ na vadāmi.

29619.meaning1: endures there; continues in that place

examples.text: phuṭṭho ḍaṃsehi makasehi, araññasmiṃ brahāvane, nāgo saṅgāmasīs'eva, sato tatr'ādhivāsaye.

29620.commentary: (VINa) tatr'āp'āsin'ti atha tatrā'pi bhave yoniyā gatiyā viññāṇaṭṭhitiyā satt'āvāse sattanikāye vā puna ahosiṃ.

examples.text: tatrā'p'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto idh'ūpapanno'ti.
tatr'āp'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, n'eva āgatiṃ vadāmi, na gatiṃ, na ṭhitiṃ, na cutiṃ, na upapattiṃ. appatiṭṭhaṃ, appavattaṃ, anārammaṇam'ev'etaṃ. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.

29622.meaning1: even in that case; even in that situation; even then

examples.text: vuttaṃ kho pan'etaṃ bhagavatā kakac'ūpam'ovāde, ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya na me so tena sāsanakaro'ti.
tasmā't'iha, phagguna, tava ce'pi koci sammukhā avaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya, tatrā'pi tvaṃ, phagguna, ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.

29623.meaning1: wishes to find pleasure there; wants to get enjoyment there
29623.commentary: (DHPa) tatr'ābhiratim'iccheyyā'ti yasmiṃ anālayasaṅkhāte viveke nibbāne imehi sattehi durabhiramaṃ, tatra abhiratiṃ iccheyya.

examples.text: tatr'ābhiratim'iccheyya, hitvā kāme akiñcano, pariyodapeyya attānaṃ, cittaklesehi paṇḍito.

29624.meaning1: in this regard this; in this case this

examples.text: tatr'āyam'ādi bhavati, idha paññassa bhikkhuno, indriyagutti santuṭṭhi, pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro.
gacchanto kho pana ujumaggen'eva gacchati, tatr'āyaṃ ujumaggo, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

29625.meaning1: there would be; there could be; there might be

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre pokkharaṇī. tatr'āssa kakkaṭako. atha kho, bhante, sambahulā kumārakā vā kumārikā vā tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā nikkhamitvā yena sā pokkharaṇī ten'upasaṅkameyyuṃ
tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, tapassitāya hoti, acelako homi mutt'ācāro hatth'āpalekhano, na ehibhaddantiko na tiṭṭhabhaddantiko

29627.meaning1: lingers there; persists there; remains there
29627.commentary: (MNa) na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī'ti taṃ kām'āvacarakammaṃ tasmiṃ rūp'ārūp'āvacarakamme na ohīyati na tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho, māṇava, mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatr'āvatiṭṭhati.

29628.meaning1: remains there; is left over there
29628.meaning2: remains there; is left over there
29628.commentary: (MNa) na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī'ti taṃ kām'āvacarakammaṃ tasmiṃ rūp'ārūp'āvacarakamme na ohīyati na tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho, māṇava, mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatr'āvatiṭṭhati.

29629.meaning1: now friend; in this case brothers

examples.text: tatr'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo?
tatr'āvuso, majjhimā bhikkhū tīhi ṭhānehi pāsaṃsā bhavanti. satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekam'anusikkhantī'ti
saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
kaṇḍuppaṭicchādiṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso catasso vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ dve vidatthiyo. taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

29632.meaning1: there these; in this connection these

examples.text: tatr'ime cattāro pārājikā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
tatr'ime bhūtā, timi timiṅgalo timitimiṅgalo asurā nāgā gandhabbā

29633.meaning1: rebirth there; re-arising in that place

examples.text: tassa te saṅkhārā ca vihārā ca evaṃ bhāvitā evaṃ bahulīkatā tatr'upapattiyā saṃvattanti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tatr'upapattiyā saṃvattati.

29635.meaning1: relevant to that; related to that; pertinent to that; suitable for that

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, subhūti, bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ ucc'āvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tatra dakkho hoti analaso tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.

29637.meaning1: rebirth there; being reborn in that place
29637.commentary: (ANa) tatr'ūpapattiyā saṃvattatī'ti yaṃ ṭhānaṃ patthetvā kusalaṃ kataṃ, tattha nibbattan'atthāya saṃvattati.

examples.text: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, n'atthi sabbaso āruppā'ti, sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati, ye te devā rūpino manomayā, apaṇṇakaṃ me tatr'ūpapatti bhavissati.
so taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. tassa taṃ cittaṃ hīne vimuttaṃ, uttari abhāvitaṃ, tatr'ūpapattiyā saṃvattati.

29638.meaning1: who get reborn there; who reappear there

29639.meaning1: reborn there; re-arisen in that place
29639.commentary: (VVa) tatr'ūpapannā'ti gāthāya ayaṃ saṅkhep'attho, tatra tasmiṃ yathāvutte vimāne upapannā'ti nibbattā pag'eva uppannattā pubbadevatā imā purimā accharāyo parimāṇato sataṃ sahassāni.

examples.text: yā tā devatā buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā ito cutā tatr'ūpapannā tāsaṃ evaṃ hoti, yathārūpena kho mayaṃ buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā tato cutā idhūpapannā, ariyasāvako'pi tathārūpena buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato ehī'ti devānaṃ santike'ti.
tatr'ūpapannā purim'accharā imā, sataṃ sahassāni sakena kammunā, tuvaṃ'si ajjhupagatā yasassinī, obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhasi pubbadevatā.

29640.meaning2: being the appropriate means for that

29641.meaning1: there someone; in this case some; in this regard someone

examples.text: evaṃ vutte kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti? tatr'ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, ahetū appaccayā purisassa saññā uppajjanti'pi nirujjhanti'pi. yasmiṃ samaye uppajjanti, saññī tasmiṃ samaye hoti.
tatr'ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, rūpā kāmānaṃ aggan'ti. ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, saddā kāmānaṃ aggan'ti. ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, gandhā kāmānaṃ aggan'ti. ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, rasā kāmānaṃ aggan'ti.

29642.meaning1: there one; in that a case a certain

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū sampayojesuṃ, tatr'eko bhikkhu accasarā, atha kho so bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno santike accayaṃ accayato deseti, so bhikkhu nappaṭiggaṇhāti.
addasā kho aggikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, tatr'eva, muṇḍaka, tatr'eva, samaṇaka, tatr'eva, vasalaka tiṭṭhāhī'ti.

yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, kāyagatāsati bhāvitā bahulīkatā, so yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, no ce assaddhiyaṃ avatiṭṭhati, yaso ca kittī ca tatv'assa hoti, saggañ'ca so gacchati sarīraṃ vihāyā'ti.
tapanīyāni kammāni, yāni dhammehi ārakā, tāni ārocayissāmi, taṃ suṇātha yathā tathaṃ.

29646.commentary: (DNa) tath'eva taṃ hotī'ti idaṃ ek'aṃsena tath'eva hoti.

examples.text: tatra, sunakkhatta, ye te bhikkhū samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaṃsu tesaṃ taṃ tath'eva hoti, ye pana te bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsu tatra, sunakkhatta, tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti, dhammaṃ nesaṃ desessan'ti.
idha, bhante, ekacco nimittena ādisati, evam'pi te mano, ittham'pi te mano, iti'pi te cittan'ti. so bahuṃ ce'pi ādisati, tath'eva taṃ hoti, no aññathā. ayaṃ paṭhamā ādesanavidhā.

29647.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ariṭṭho upariṭṭho tagarasikhī yasassī, sudassano piyadassī ca susambuddho, gandhāro piṇḍolo upāsabho ca, nīto tatho sutavā bhāvit'atto.
passathā'ti c'āha avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā. iti kho, bhikkhave, yā tatra tathatā avitathatā anaññathatā idappaccayatā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paṭiccasamuppādo.

29649.meaning1: such a state; such a condition

examples.text: atha khv'assa pubb'eva tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃ taṃ tath'attāya upanetī'ti.

29650.commentary: (MNa) tathattāyā'ti yaṃ so dhammaṃ deseti tathā bhāvāya, dhamm'ānudhamma-paṭipatti-pūraṇ'atthāya paṭipajjantī'ti attho.

examples.text: luddho pan'āyaṃ, kālāmā, purisapuggalo lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pāṇam'pi hanati, adinnam'pi ādiyati, paradāram'pi gacchati, musā'pi bhaṇati, param'pi tath'attāya samādapeti, yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.

ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ kāmānaṃ assādañ'ca assādato ādīnavañ'ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ'ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti te vata sāmaṃ vā kāme parijānissanti, paraṃ vā tath'attāya samādapessanti yathā paṭipanno kāme parijānissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

29652.commentary: (THa) dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu tathattan'ti taṃ tathabhāvaṃ sammāpaṭipannaṃ yāthāvato dhammadassī'ti paṇḍitā āhu.

examples.text: na hi socati bhikkhu kadāci, maggajino sammā paṭipanno, kittiñ'ca sukhañ'c'ānubhoti, dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu tath'attaṃ.

29653.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of tathatta

examples.text: samitāvi pahāya puññapāpaṃ, virajo ñatvā imaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ, jātimaraṇaṃ upātivatto, samaṇo tādi pavuccate tathattā.
khettāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakhettaṃ, sabbakhettamūlabandhanā pamutto, khettajino tādi pavuccate tathattā.

29654.meaning2: to do likewise; lit. for taking up like that
29654.commentary: (ANa) yo ca samādapito tath'attāya paṭipajjatī'ti yo antevāsiko ācariyena samādapito tassa vacanaṃ karonto tathābhāvāya paṭipajjati.

examples.text: durakkhāte, bhikkhave, dhammavinaye yo ca samādapeti yañ'ca samādapeti yo ca samādapito tath'attāya paṭipajjati sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.
musā'pi bhaṇati, param'pi tath'attāya samādapeti, yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.
evaṃ bhaṇeti, bhaṇayati, bhaṇāpeti, bhaṇāpayati. bhaṇenti, bhaṇayanti, bhaṇāpenti, bhaṇāpayanti. tatha'riva aññe'pi yojetabbā.

29656.meaning1: true characteristic; immutable quality; (comm) unchangeable nature

examples.text: vipassanā hi tīṇi lakkhaṇāni upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. maggo vipassanāya āgatakiccaṃ sādhetī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. phalaṃ tathalakkhaṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ.

29660.meaning1: so; thus; in such a way; likewise; similarly
29660.meaning2: thus, so, in that way, likewise

examples.text: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ
atthaṅ'gato so uda vā so n'atthi, udāhu ve sassatiyā arogo, taṃ me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

29661.meaning1: in those ways; just like that; in that manner

examples.text: yathā yathā vā pan'assa kāyo paṇihito hoti tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti

yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.
yathā kathaṃ pana, bhante, ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hoti? sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hotī'ti

29664.meaning2: for so; for thus (as it has been said); for instance; because

29666.commentary: (DNa) yathāvādī'ti yaṃ vācāya vadati, tadanvayam'ev'assa kāyakammaṃ hoti. yañ'ca kāyena karoti, tadanvayam'ev'assa vacīkammaṃ hoti. kāyo vā vācaṃ, vācā vā kāyaṃ n'ātikkamati, vācā kāyena, kāyo ca vācāya sameti.

examples.text: yathāvādī kho pana so bhagavā tathākārī, yathākārī tathāvādī, iti yathāvādī tathākārī, yathākārī tathāvādī.

29667.meaning1: Such Become; realized; being in such a state; arrived at the truth; epithet of the Buddha
29667.meaning2: who has gone so, Enlighten One
29667.notes: Bhikkhu Sujāta: the EBTs give a fairly extensive set of interpretations for tathāgata, for example, 'as he says, so he does'. The overall sense is of one who speaks and acts in accordance with his realization of the truth, which fits the translation 'the realized One'.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.
n'āhaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, passāmi… yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.

29668.meaning1: going in that direction; headed that way
29668.meaning2: (one) who goes in that way; goes accordingly

examples.text: sace so samantā tīraṃ passati, tathāgatako'va hoti. sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati, tam'eva nāvaṃ paccāgacchati.

29671.meaning1: track of the Such Become; trace of the Buddha

examples.text: idam'pi vuccati, brāhmaṇa, tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pi, tathāgatanisevitaṃ iti'pi, tathāgat'ārañjitaṃ iti'pi. na tv'eva tāva ariyasāvako niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.

29672.meaning1: the last words of the Tathāgata; the final utterance of the Buddha

29673.meaning1: footprint of the Such Become; footstep of the Buddha
29673.commentary: (MNa) tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pī'ti idam'pi tathāgatassa ñāṇapadaṃ ñāṇavaḷañjaṃ ñāṇena akkantaṭṭhānan'ti vuccati

examples.text: idam'pi vuccati, brāhmaṇa, tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pi, tathāgatanisevitaṃ iti'pi, tathāgat'ārañjitaṃ iti'pi. na tv'eva tāva ariyasāvako niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.

29674.meaning1: preached by the realized One; proclaimed by the Such Become

examples.text: evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, vessakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma, evaṃ mettaṃ karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ bhāvetvā labhati ajjhattaṃ vūpasamaṃ.

29675.meaning2: supreme intellectual power of the Tathāgata

examples.text: dasa'y'imāni, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni, yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti. katamāni dasa?

yam'pi, sāriputta, tathāgato anekadhātunānādhātulokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idam'pi, sāriputta, tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.

29676.meaning1: spoken by the Buddha; preached by the Buddha

examples.text: ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatappaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti

29677.meaning1: Buddha's teaching; instruction of the Buddha

examples.text: yo so, sāriputta, ariyasāvako tathāgate ek'antagato abhippasanno, na so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā'ti?
n'āhaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, passāmi… yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.

so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhāna-adhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhāna-abhinivesa-anusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.

yāvatā, bhikkhave, saṅghā vā gaṇā vā, tathāgatasāvakasaṅgho tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. ye, bhikkhave, saṅghe pasannā, agge te pasannā.

29684.meaning1: lying posture of the Such Become
29684.commentary: (SNa) catutthajjhānaseyyā pana tathāgataseyyā'ti vuccati. tāsu idha sīhaseyyā āgatā. ayañ'hi tej'ussada-iriyāpathattā uttamaseyyā nāma.

examples.text: katamā catasso? petaseyyā, kāmabhogiseyyā, sīhaseyyā, tathāgataseyyā. katamā ca, bhikkhave, petaseyyā?

29685.meaning1: sayings of the Tathāgata, word of the Buddha

29686.meaning1: regarding the Such Become; about the Buddha

examples.text: tathāgatavasena sattamanayabhūmiparicchedo niṭṭhito.

29687.meaning1: Buddha's meditation; Buddha's dwelling; Buddha's state of mind

examples.text: yañ'hi taṃ, bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pi, ān'āpānassatisamādhiṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pī'ti.

29690.meaningLit: group of ten discourses starting with the discourse on the Tathāgata

29691.meaning2: (a place rubbed by) the frequenting of the tathāgata, trace of the tathāgata

29692.meaning1: marking of the Such Become; a place furrowed by the Buddha

examples.text: idam'pi vuccati, brāhmaṇa, tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pi, tathāgatanisevitaṃ iti'pi, tathāgat'ārañjitaṃ iti'pi. na tv'eva tāva ariyasāvako niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.

29694.meaning2: state of being so; true state of things

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā yathādhotena pattena pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi tathādhotena pattena paṭikkami.

29697.commentary: (KVa) tathānāsitan'ti ettha saṃvāsanāsanā liṅganāsanā daṇḍakammanāsanā'ti tisso nāsanā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathānāsitaṃ samaṇ'uddesaṃ upalāpeyya vā, upaṭṭhāpeyya vā, sambhuñjeyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

29699.meaning1: setting out in that direction; going that way
29699.meaning2: leaving thus; departing in that way

examples.text: sace so samantā tīraṃ passati, tathāpakkanto'va hoti. sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati, tam'eva nāvaṃ paccāgacchati.
